headline: A thinner sukuk auction (bids Rp20.1tn vs Rp28.6tn) and another record JISDOR fix (18,264) a day before BI cheapen the 5–7Y ~3bp and lift the 10Y 2.1bp to 7.72%, despite a 3bp Treasury rally; the 1Y falls to 6.72% and the daily flow signal is −0.84
summary: PHEI's IGSYC steepened again from the 2Y: the 1Y fell 3.8bp to 6.720% and the 2Y 1.9bp to 7.011%, while the 5Y rose 3.2bp to 7.513%, the 7Y 2.8bp to 7.652% and the 10Y 2.1bp to 7.718%, 0.7bp under its one-year high of 7.724% (Nov 4). 2s5s widened 5.1bp to 50.2bp (93rd percentile of 14 stored days) and the 2s5s10s fly 6.2bp to 29.7bp; the 1M, unusually, rose 5.9bp to 6.176%. Benchmark FR0109 lost 7.2bp to 7.531% (9.6bp cheap to the curve) and FR0108 5.7bp to 7.661% (5.1bp rich). After the auction PBS034 rose 5.5bp to 7.699% and PBS040 4.8bp to 7.519% (12.3bp cheap), leaving the fitted PBS 5Y 0.4bp over IGSYC, the cheapest of 13 stored days; the retail fit is 13.1bp rich at 5Y and AAA 3Y is unchanged at 48.7bp over.
drivers: Record JISDOR the day before BI

JISDOR fixed 0.08% weaker at 18,264, a fresh record, although spot closed 0.07% firmer at 18,256 after touching 18,285 intraday (Kontan). Polls are split for Wednesday: 7 of 13 in CNBC Indonesia's poll expect a 25bp hike to 6.00%, while a Bloomberg survey cited by BRI Danareksa has a majority for a hold at 5.75%. The 5–7Y took the hit (+2.8–3.2bp) and 2s5s steepened 5.1bp; why the 1Y–2Y kept rallying (−1.9 to −3.8bp) is not published, and short-paper demand from banks parking liquidity is my hypothesis, not buyer-level data.

The government awarded Rp10tn, exactly the indicative target, from Rp20.10tn of bids, down from Rp28.56tn at the Nov 3 sukuk auction (Reuters); series-level yields were not in the sources I read. The reopened bonds cheapened in the secondary market, PBS034 +5.5bp and PBS040 +4.8bp, and the fitted PBS 5Y moved from 0.8bp through IGSYC to 0.4bp over. Ministry of Finance data still show foreign SBN inflows of Rp4.7tn in November to Nov 11, but that does not rule out selling since.
Treasuries rallied; INDOGBs did not follow

The US 10Y fell about 3bp on Monday to 5.12% (5.115% on Tradeweb) after Fed Chair Warsh's remarks and softer stocks. At the 1-year daily beta of 0.30 that implies −0.9bp for the INDOGB 10Y; it rose 2.1bp, so Treasuries explain none of today's move. The INDOGB − UST spread widened to 259.8bp from 254.7bp (75th percentile of 52 weeks, range 191–300bp), a nominal pick-up before currency risk.
Stocks slipped; foreigners net sellers by most counts

The JCI gave up a 1% morning gain to close 0.30% lower at 5,304.75; Kontan reports a foreign net sell of Rp484bn across all markets, led by BBCA, while BRI Danareksa data show a near-flat Rp6.6bn net buy, so counts differ. Over 20 sessions the JCI is down 13.3% and USD/IDR up 1.97%, which keeps the equity and rupiah parts of the flow signal bearish.
data: Bids Rp20.10tn, awarded Rp10tn (f target Rp10tn, p bids Rp28.56tn on Nov 3)
Bid cover fell to about 2x; reopened PBS034/PBS040 cheapened ~5bp after the result.
Government external debt rose to $220.2bn, which BI ties partly to foreign SBN buying; little direct read for yields.
Slight miss; Treasuries sold off anyway on Friday, then rallied 3bp on Monday.
Deficit 1.47% of GDP (f n/a, p 1.24% through Sep)
On track; Rp945tn of spending left for Nov–Dec, financed with five auctions, keeps supply steady.
Inflows through Nov 11 per the Ministry of Finance; they do not rule out selling since.
Started last week's US sell-off and the December Fed-hike pricing.
Bids Rp79.71tn (p Rp31.09tn); awarded Rp35tn vs Rp30tn target; FR0110 7.44%, FR0111 7.68%
Strong conventional demand at higher yields; today's sukuk book was far smaller.
view: The rupiah and BI, not Treasuries, still set the price: a 3bp US rally left the 10Y 2.1bp higher, and the belly cheapened into a thinner sukuk book with JISDOR at a record. The daily Bond Flow Signal is −0.84 (sell-off; −0.77 yesterday on today's rebuild): the 10Y trend part is the most bearish (z +1.85, +53.9bp over 20 sessions), then the JCI (z −1.35, −13.3%) and the rupiah (z +0.75, +1.97%), while the spread, 15.8bp above its 130-day average (z +0.60), leans bond-bullish; the sell-off episode on the daily build runs from Sep 30 (23 sessions, +60.0bp). Since July 2022 the daily signal scores a Sharpe of 0.65 outright (173bp) and 0.72 hedged against Treasuries (191bp), against −43bp for holding the 10Y, but sell-off calls were right only 52% of the time over the next 20 sessions (hedged 52%; rally calls 58%, hedged 64.5%) and the 10Y fell 1.0bp on average after them; on the same daily build the outright Sharpe was 1.01 in Jul 2022–Aug 2024 and 0.41 since. The weekly build scores 0.44 and 0.54; a variant using the US 10Y trend reaches 0.89 and 0.91 on the weekly build but was chosen after the fact and is not live, and all of these are in-sample back-tests. Over four weeks the INDOGB 10Y is up 26bp while the US 10Y rose 16bp, yet at the weekly beta of −0.21 the Treasury-linked part is −3.4bp and +29.4bp is residual, the part Treasuries do not explain. I stay neutral on the 10Y in a 7.55–7.80% range through BI, keep the 5Y as the curve trade (buy FR0109 at 7.60–7.70%, now 7bp away), and see the 1–2Y, 97bp over the BI-Rate, as the most exposed to a hike.

buckets.name: Front end 1–2Y vs BI-Rate
buckets.why: The IGSYC 1Y fell 3.8bp to 6.720%, 97.0bp over the 5.75% BI-Rate, the narrowest of 14 stored days (7th percentile, average 107.6bp) and now below my 6.75% no-chase line; the 2Y fell 1.9bp to 7.011% and 1s2s widened to 29.1bp, the steepest stored. The 3M (0.25Y) is 6.27% and the 1M rose 5.9bp to 6.18%. The 7.10% add level was not reached (38bp away); no position.
buckets.call: Neutral. Add 1–2Y only at 1Y 7.10% or after a BI hike that steadies JISDOR; a 25bp hike on Nov 18 would leave the 1Y only ~72bp over the new rate, so this bucket has the most to lose.

buckets.name: Belly 5Y (FR0109 / PBS040)
buckets.why: The IGSYC 5Y rose 3.2bp to 7.513% (64th percentile of 14 stored days, average 7.493%), +4.4bp this week; the 2s5s10s fly rose 6.2bp to 29.7bp (64th percentile, average 25.6bp). FR0109 lost 7.2bp to 7.531% and is 9.6bp cheap to the curve; PBS040 at 7.519% is 12.3bp cheap after its reopening. The entry (FR0109 7.60–7.70%) is now 7bp away and not filled.
buckets.call: Buy FR0109 at 7.60–7.70% after a BI hike or with JISDOR back below 18,000; target 7.35%, stop 7.95%.

buckets.name: 10Y outright
buckets.why: The IGSYC 10Y rose 2.1bp to 7.718%, 99th percentile of the past year (172 days, average 6.84%) and 0.7bp under the 7.724% high of Nov 4, against a 3bp US rally. The signal is −0.84, but the underweight rule also needs a 10Y close above 7.75%, so it is not triggered and the 7.55–7.80% range holds. FR0108 rose 5.7bp to 7.661% and is 5.1bp rich.
buckets.call: Neutral, range 7.55–7.80%. Underweight if the signal stays below −0.5 and the 10Y closes above 7.75%; tactical long only above 7.85% (stop 8.05%) or once the signal is above 0 with JISDOR below 18,000.

buckets.name: 10s20s curve (FR0108 vs FR0107)
buckets.why: IGSYC 10s20s is 1.4bp (43rd percentile of 14 stored days, average 1.4bp, range 0.1–2.9bp); the range is tiny. The benchmark spread FR0107 − FR0108 narrowed to 4.7bp from 11.0bp as FR0108 lost 5.7bp and FR0107 gained 0.5bp, now 9.7bp from the −5bp re-entry.
buckets.call: Wait. Re-enter the FR0108/FR0107 steepener duration-weighted at −5bp or lower, target +5bp, stop −12bp.

buckets.name: PBS sukuk vs FR
buckets.stance: Hold FR over PBS034; PBS040 is the cheap one
buckets.why: After the auction the fitted PBS 5Y is 0.4bp over IGSYC, the cheapest of 13 stored days (100th percentile, average −1.5bp); the 2Y is 1.2bp over and the 10Y 0.2bp through. The fit rests on four series (level −0.8bp, slope 3.1bp), so confidence is limited. PBS034 rose 5.5bp to 7.699% and is now 2.7bp rich; on the benchmark-history measure its richness fell 3.6bp today, a gain for the FR-over-PBS034 switch, which stays open with the switch-back (PBS034 5bp cheap) 7.7bp away. The PBS040 auction bid (7.45–7.50%) cannot be scored: series results were not in my sources, and PBS040 closed at 7.519%.
buckets.call: Hold FR over PBS034; switch back once PBS034 is 5bp cheap to IGSYC. Buy-and-hold accounts can add PBS040 at 7.50–7.55% (12bp cheap to the curve).

buckets.name: Corporate credit (AAA 3Y)
buckets.why: PHEI's AAA 3Y rose 1.1bp to 7.710%, in line with IGSYC, so the spread held at 48.7bp, the narrowest of 13 stored days (8th percentile, average 50.2bp). AA is 90.2bp over (92nd percentile, average 86.3bp), A 151.5bp over, and BBB 223.2bp over AA (15th percentile, average 238.6bp). Thirteen days is a thin base; the add level (AAA 3Y past 70bp) was not reached.
buckets.call: Hold AAA/AA; add only if AAA 3Y widens past 70bp. Avoid BBB until the rupiah and politics settle.

buckets.name: Retail SBN 5Y (ORI/SR)
buckets.why: The fitted retail curve is 13.1bp through IGSYC at 5Y (54th percentile of 13 stored days, average −13.4bp) and 5.6bp over at 2Y; the fit now uses 25 series with a 71bp slope, so part of this is fit artefact. Secondary spreads run from 53bp rich (SR024T3) to 47bp cheap (ORI027T3); ORI026T6 is 7.627%, 33bp over. ST017 (open to Dec 2) floors at 6.95% (2Y) and 7.05% (4Y), below the IGSYC 2Y (7.01%).
buckets.call: For new money, FR0109 or PBS040 give daily liquidity; ST017 suits hold-to-maturity buyers who want BI-hike upside. Buy secondary retail only at the cheap end (ORI026T6, ~33bp over).

sbsn:5.note: Fitted 0.4bp over, cheapest stored; PBS040 12bp cheap

watch: Next: US October retail sales and industrial production (Tue Nov 17, New York), BI's decision at 14:30 Jakarta time and September loan growth (Wed Nov 18), FOMC minutes (Wed Nov 18), Indonesia's Q3 balance of payments (Fri Nov 20), MSCI changes after the Nov 30 close, the ST017 book closing Dec 2 and FTSE deletions on Dec 21; a 10Y close above 7.75% would trigger the underweight, while JISDOR back below 18,000 would push a BI hike out.
